name: O3b / O3b mPOWER (MEO comms)
tagline: Only operational MEO commercial broadband — 20+ sats
description: The only operational commercial MEO broadband constellation — original O3b deployed 2013-2019, second-generation O3b mPOWER from 2022 onwards. 20+ satellites at 8,063 km equatorial orbit. Latency between GEO and LEO, customer base focused on telecom backhaul, maritime, and remote enterprise. Operated by SES (Luxembourg). Named for the 'other 3 billion' — the original mission was bringing connectivity to areas not served by terrestrial broadband.
best_known_for: Only operational MEO commercial broadband — 20+ sats
